digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate measurement and calibration (E2 defect benchmark)
propositions: A deterministic seeded-defect mutant corpus with 5 defect classes (absent asserted capability, layer-cake split, consumed-artifact-without-ordering-edge, unnecessary mechanism, untagged operational AC) was designed and built as WIP on branch calib/6982-e2 with mechanically-injected defects into real cleanly-closed plans to establish known ground truth.

Pre-registered detection and false-positive thresholds per defect class and an INDETERMINATE run-validity cap (≥0.20) were fixed in runs/e2_thresholds.json; pure counting helpers (classify_pair, run_validity) were implemented in e2_counting.py with golden tests and store-clone isolation via git clone --local.

An expensive ~100-run live LLM batch baseline sweep over the mutant corpus to produce e2_baseline.json / e2_run_validity.json / e2_verdicts.jsonl was permanently rejected on cost and superseded by story d8a5 (change #798, MERGED), which accumulates the same detection/blocking-FP signal from production reviews at $0 marginal LLM cost.
History-based baseline mining is dead: only ~4 plan-v3 sidecar baselines exist against ~200 needed due to impact_model_version version stranding, eliminating a fallback measurement source.

The deterministic harness build (corpus, thresholds, assemble/benchmark seams, counting helpers, golden tests) was intentionally NOT landed on main because its only runtime purpose is to drive the rejected batch.
The ticket was operator-approved for rescope and close on 2026-07-18 with deterministic WIP recorded on calib/6982-e2 and batch deferral rationale documented.
